item.title: Residents of Kenya's Lamu island fear damage from mega-refinery
item.description: The Kenyan island of Lamu is known for its stunning Indian Ocean setting and 12th century old town. Cars are non-existent here and transport mostly happens by donkey or traditional dhow sailing boat. But the island is about to become home to one of Kenya’s largest industrial projects.
item.author: editorial@africanews.com

item.title: Russian president warns Moscow will use ‘all weapons’ to defend Kaliningrad

item.title: Mobile labs speed up Ebola testing in eastern DR Congo
item.description: In the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, a mobile lab has been operating for two weeks, a welcome relief to staff at the nearby Ebola treatment centre who said that getting a test result used to take 72 hours.
